property_summary: General rule: any fallback call made at a timestamp not strictly greater than pastBlockTime must revert, so a second call in the same block timestamp always fails in C; the mutant deletes this require and lets the second call succeed (and pay out), so for some fuzzed input the second call does not revert.
change_summary: Delete `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` so a second call in the same timestamp no longer reverts and can update `pastBlockTime` when P would have kept it unchanged.
